verdict.rationale: Omnara is an agent platform, so isolated sandbox execution is a fair axis to judge it on. The pack never documents a sandbox, container isolation, or dependency installation. The nearest items are adjacent and earn no credit: agents can run on a connected machine such as a laptop or server, actions can require approval, and connected machines need no inbound network path.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have an agent safely execute code and install dependencies inside an isolated sandbox
